newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Quantum says no reason for share leap.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Quantum says no reason for share leap.

text.p: Gold explorer Quantum Resources NL, which is part of mining entrepreneur Joseph Gutnick stable of companies, said on Tuesday it knows no reason for the recent rise in its share price.

Quantum said in response to a query from the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) that it knew of no reason for the rise in its share price, which at 11.10 a.m. (0010 GMT) is at a record high of A$4.50, 30 cents or 7.14 percent up on Monday's close.
The ASX query follows the rise in Quantum share price from A$2.81 on November 7, a day before former Australian Prime Minister Bob Hawke joined the Quantum board.

Quantum forms part of the Gutnick-controlled group of mining companies, led by Great Central Mines NL, and has plans to expand into China and other parts of Asia with the help of Bob Hawke, who is now a business consultant.
